The victor was decided, and praises 
erupted. At the center stood Symboli 
Rudolf, exchanging praise with Maruzensky 
for a hard-fought race.

Having been reminded once more of the joy 
of running, Symboli Rudolf expressed her 
wish for all Umamusume to experience this 
same happiness.

At the press conference held afterward, 
Symboli Rudolf spoke once more of her 
dream as the "Emperor." On this day, a 
true "Emperor" was born.
